description: Lagging power factor percentage equals active energy divided by the lagging apparent-energy magnitude, multiplied by 100.
rationale: For lagging current, active energy and lagging reactive energy form the orthogonal components of apparent energy; the power-factor definition is the active component over their Euclidean magnitude.
check_code:
def check(df):
    q = df["Lagging_Current_Reactive_Power_kVarh"]
    p = df["Usage_kWh"]
    expected = 100.0 * p / np.sqrt(p * p + q * q)
    return (df["Lagging_Current_Power_Factor"] - expected).abs() <= 0.03

fix_code.code:
def fix(df):
    q = df['Lagging_Current_Reactive_Power_kVarh']
    p = df['Usage_kWh']
    qv = q.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    pv = p.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    denominator = np.sqrt(pv * pv + qv * qv)
    result = np.zeros_like(pv, dtype=float)
    np.divide(100.0 * pv, denominator, out=result, where=denominator != 0)
    result = np.nan_to_num(result, nan=0.0, posinf=100.0, neginf=0.0)
    return pd.Series(result, index=p.index, dtype=float)

def fix(df):
    q = np.abs(df['Lagging_Current_Reactive_Power_kVarh'])
    pf = df['Lagging_Current_Power_Factor']
    denom = np.sqrt((10000.0 - pf * pf).clip(lower=0.0))
    inverted = q * pf / denom.where(denom > 0.0, 1.0)
    result = inverted.where(denom > 0.0, 1000000.0 * (q + 1.0))
    return result.where(q != 0.0, 1.0).astype(float)

description: Leading power factor percentage equals active energy divided by the leading apparent-energy magnitude, multiplied by 100.
rationale: For leading current, active energy and leading reactive energy are the orthogonal components of apparent energy; the power-factor definition uses the same magnitude relationship regardless of reactive-current direction.
check_code:
def check(df):
    q = df["Leading_Current_Reactive_Power_kVarh"]
    p = df["Usage_kWh"]
    expected = 100.0 * p / np.sqrt(p * p + q * q)
    return (df["Leading_Current_Power_Factor"] - expected).abs() <= 0.03

fix_code.code:
def fix(df):
    q = df['Leading_Current_Reactive_Power_kVarh']
    p = df['Usage_kWh']
    denominator = np.sqrt(p * p + q * q)
    result = np.zeros_like(p, dtype=float)
    np.divide(100.0 * p, denominator, out=result, where=denominator != 0.0)
    return pd.Series(result, index=p.index)

def fix(df):
    q = df['Leading_Current_Reactive_Power_kVarh'].abs()
    r = df['Leading_Current_Power_Factor']
    denominator = np.sqrt(np.maximum(10000.0 - r * r, 0.0))
    inverted = q * r / denominator
    fallback = 100.0 * q + 1.0
    result = np.where(r < 100.0, inverted, fallback)
    return pd.Series(result, index=q.index, dtype=float)
